body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: Four short cellar passages meet at a cramped junction. Unequal arches, makeshift curtains and low shelves form a small refuge. Mercenaries socialize in two side passages; the mage remains at the dark threshold nearest the viewer. COMPOSITION: Low oblique view through a side doorway; a massive central pier blocks the direct route and divides groups. COLOR SCRIPT: silver gray, deep pine green, dark umber, very small golden light. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
